summary: @velliajs/discord ships hardcoded GitHub PAT and unpinned git+https dependency enabling install-time code injection
details: @velliajs/discord@1.0.7 presents itself as a Discord bot library and re-exports the discord.js API surface, but package.json declares its `sysframe` dependency as `git+https://ghp_<redacted>@github.com/navaLinh/node-ai.git`, a private GitHub repository referenced without a commit SHA. On `npm install`, npm clones and installs whatever code that repository currently contains, outside the npm registry's visibility and mutable by the repository owner at any time. A second live GitHub personal access token is embedded in src/client/Client.js inside `_validateAuthOptions`. Client.login() also invokes a hidden `_verifyAuthorization` path that, when a second constructor argument is supplied, calls Discord's /users/@me with the caller's bot token and then queries the author-controlled private repo Vellia-Elyvia/mydb (db.json) through api.github.com using the hardcoded PAT to gate login on a per-bot allowlist. This combination provides an install-time code-injection channel via the unpinned git+https dependency, ships two live third-party credentials to every installer, and adds a covert author-controlled kill-switch/observation surface over the advertised discord.js behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
